verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ בִּ֭נְגִינוֹת עַֽל־ הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי בְּאַפְּךָ֥ וְֽאַל־ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃ בַּחֲמָתְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nō·wṯ ‘al- haš·šə·mî·nîṯ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ’al- ṯō·w·ḵî·ḥê·nî bə·’ap·pə·ḵā wə·’al- ṯə·yas·sə·rê·nî ba·ḥă·mā·ṯə·ḵā
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments according to Sheminith A Psalm of David O LORD do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אָ֥נִי אֻמְלַ֫ל רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י עֲצָמָֽי׃ נִבְהֲל֣וּ
verses.transliteration: ḥān·nê·nî Yah·weh kî ’ā·nî ’um·lal rə·p̄ā·’ê·nî Yah·weh kî ‘ă·ṣā·māy niḇ·hă·lū
verses.literal: Be merciful to me O LORD for I am frail heal me O LORD for my bones are in agony

verses.original: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַד־ וְאַתְּ יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nap̄·šî niḇ·hă·lāh mə·’ōḏ ‘aḏ- wə·ʾat Yah·weh mā·ṯāy
verses.literal: My soul is deeply distressed . . . How long O LORD how long

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šū·ḇāh Yah·weh ḥal·lə·ṣāh nap̄·šî hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî lə·ma·‘an ḥas·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Turn O LORD [and] deliver my soul save me because of Your loving devotion

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בַּמָּ֣וֶת מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה־ לָּֽךְ׃ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל
verses.transliteration: kî ’ên ziḵ·re·ḵā bam·mā·weṯ mî yō·w·ḏeh- lāḵ biš·’ō·wl
verses.literal: For there is no mention of You in death who can praise You from Sheol

verses.original: יָגַ֤עְתִּי׀ בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י בְכָל־ לַ֭יְלָה אַשְׂחֶ֣ה מִטָּתִ֑י אַמְסֶֽה׃ עַרְשִׂ֥י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י
verses.transliteration: yā·ḡa‘·tî bə·’an·ḥā·ṯî ḇə·ḵāl- lay·lāh ’aś·ḥeh miṭ·ṭā·ṯî ’am·seh ‘ar·śî bə·ḏim·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: I am weary from groaning all night I flood my bed with {weeping} [and] drench my couch with tears

verses.original: עֵינִ֑י עָֽשְׁשָׁ֣ה מִכַּ֣עַס עָֽ֝תְקָ֗ה בְּכָל־ צוֹרְרָֽי׃
verses.literal: My eyes fail from grief they grow dim because of all my foes

verses.original: ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כָּל־ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥ע ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: sū·rū mim·men·nî kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen kî- Yah·weh šā·ma‘ qō·wl biḵ·yî
verses.literal: Depart from me all you workers of iniquity for the LORD has heard vvv my weeping

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣ע תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִקָּֽח׃ תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh šā·ma‘ tə·ḥin·nā·ṯî Yah·weh yiq·qāḥ tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy the LORD accepts my prayer

verses.original: כָּל־ אֹיְבָ֑י יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀ וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ רָֽגַע׃ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇāy yê·ḇō·šū wə·yib·bā·hă·lū mə·’ōḏ yā·šu·ḇū rā·ḡa‘ yê·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed . . . they will turn back in sudden disgrace
